about: Shared by tests/push_text_fixture.rs (src/push/detail.rs::first_line) and NotificationContentComposerTests (NotificationContentComposer.flattened). `rust` is what the daemon sends for `input` as the first line of one field; `swift` is what the phone shows for `input` as the whole of a detail text (the daemon sends one line, so the two differ only where the input has more than one). null means no text. Inputs are JSON-escaped so the invisible characters are visible here.

cases.name: plain text is unchanged
LF ends the line: Rust keeps the first, Kit joins the lines with a space
CR ends the line: Rust keeps the first, Kit joins the lines with a space
VT ends the line: Rust keeps the first, Kit joins the lines with a space
FF ends the line: Rust keeps the first, Kit joins the lines with a space
NEL ends the line: Rust keeps the first, Kit joins the lines with a space
LS ends the line: Rust keeps the first, Kit joins the lines with a space
PS ends the line: Rust keeps the first, Kit joins the lines with a space
CRLF is one line break
blank lines of every kind are skipped
a tab is a space
runs of spaces collapse

control characters are dropped, not turned into spaces
zero-width space is dropped
bidi controls are dropped
